title: 供体感知且QC稳健的SPP1巨噬细胞代谢状态重建
question: 锚点提出的ATP5F1E与MT-CO1分型在去除线粒体QC组织研究和治疗混杂后是否仍成立，能否用可复现的多基因程序替代单marker并在CRC与CRLM空间中验证？
target_disease: colorectal cancer and colorectal liver metastasis
comparison: matched and cohort-stratified CRC versus CRLM and adjacent tissues with QC treatment and study sensitivity
primary_outcome: locked program donor-level effect size cross-cohort reproducibility and patient-level spatial localization
claim_ceiling: retrospective multi-cohort association of reproducible macrophage metabolic transcriptional states; no metabolic flux lineage or causal therapy claim
falsifier: removing mitochondrial genes and adjusting pct.mt donor tissue study and treatment eliminates the state or two independent cohorts fail to reproduce its direction
anchor_reuse: cross-anatomical atlas;myeloid zoom-in;metabolic subdivision;spatial and clinical evidence order
changed_axes: single-marker subtype to multigene program;cell-level to donor-level inference;primary-only spatial to CRC plus CRLM;causal therapy module omitted
science_basis: It preserves the anchor's most distinctive but least secure framework asset, has public discovery and validation candidates, can fail early, and is less duplicative than another generic SPP1 signature. Publication value depends on identifying a stable program rather than merely disproving one marker.
estimated_calendar_time: 12-16 weeks after a 1-2 week feasibility spike
main_risk: The stable program may disappear after correct QC or may remain too close to already published CRLM macrophage studies
stop_condition: stop or reroute if no candidate program survives donor-aware QC in GSE164522 and an independent cohort or if nearest-literature review shows the final claim is already published

title: 细胞来源分辨的SPP1免疫排斥生态
question: 巨噬细胞来源的SPP1程序是否比肿瘤细胞或CAF来源的SPP1更稳定地关联CRLM中的CD8 T细胞空间排斥？
target_disease: colorectal cancer and colorectal liver metastasis
target_object: cell-source-specific SPP1 programs and CD8 T-cell exclusion
comparison: macrophage-derived versus tumour-derived versus fibroblast-derived SPP1 programs across primary CRC and CRLM
primary_outcome: patient-level source-specific SPP1 program association with spatial CD8 proximity and exhaustion programs
claim_ceiling: source-resolved retrospective spatial and transcriptomic association; no causal ligand-source claim without perturbation
falsifier: after tumour purity CAF abundance tissue and study adjustment macrophage-specific SPP1 has no independent association or the source assignment fails spatial negative controls
anchor_reuse: SPP1 focal object;single-cell to spatial to immune-ecology sequence;competing cell interactions
changed_axes: absolute SPP1 abundance to source attribution;pooled CellChat to patient-level spatial models;therapy module omitted
science_basis: This directly repairs the anchor's source ambiguity and uses public primary and CRLM spatial data, but 2025-2026 SPP1-CAF-tumour literature makes duplication screening a major gate.
main_risk: Cell-source deconvolution may be underidentified and closely related papers already connect tumour or macrophage SPP1 to CAF and T-cell exclusion
stop_condition: stop if spatial source assignment cannot pass synthetic-mixture and permutation controls or if the final source-outcome claim is already directly published

title: 部位与术前治疗共同塑造的SPP1巨噬细胞状态
question: 在患者配对的原发CRC和肝转移中，SPP1巨噬细胞程序的差异有多少来自转移部位，有多少与术前治疗及治疗反应相关？
comparison: paired primary versus liver metastasis stratified by untreated treated and response context
primary_outcome: donor-level site by treatment interaction for a locked macrophage program
claim_ceiling: retrospective treatment-associated state remodeling; not a causal treatment-response biomarker
falsifier: metadata cannot separate site from treatment or the site by treatment effect fails in an independent cohort
changed_axes: treatment treated as design variable rather than hidden batch;interaction model replaces pooled enrichment;regorafenib claim removed
science_basis: It turns a major anchor confounder into the biological question and has GSE178318 as a public candidate, but that source paper and Cancer Discovery 2022 already studied chemotherapy-driven CRLM immune remodeling.
main_risk: Treatment labels response definitions and site may be too confounded and the central question may duplicate the data-generating papers
stop_condition: stop if no cohort contains the minimum crossed site-treatment design or nearest-literature audit leaves no distinct macrophage-specific question

title: 直接SPP1扰动与抗PD1析因验证
question: 巨噬细胞来源SPP1对CRLM免疫排斥是否必要，并与抗PD1存在预先定义的治疗交互？
target_object: macrophage-derived SPP1 necessity and treatment interaction
comparison: macrophage-specific Spp1 perturbation or direct blockade crossed with anti-PD1 in a complete factorial design
primary_outcome: predefined interaction effect on liver metastatic burden and patient-relevant CD8 functional endpoints
claim_ceiling: preclinical necessity and model-specific treatment interaction only
falsifier: SPP1-specific perturbation does not change the prespecified CD8 or metastasis endpoint or the treatment interaction interval excludes the synergy threshold
anchor_reuse: intervention ladder;SPP1 focal state;CD8 readout;combination-therapy ending
changed_axes: multikinase proxy to direct perturbation;three-arm to full factorial;source ambiguity to lineage-specific manipulation
science_basis: This is the strongest repair of the anchor's causal and synergy gaps, but it is not a beginner-only computational route and requires a committed wet-lab and animal collaborator.
estimated_calendar_time: 12-18 months with an established wet-lab collaborator
main_risk: Wet-lab access cost power randomization and independent replication are outside the current confirmed resources
stop_condition: keep only as backup unless a named collaborator accepts the direct-perturbation and full-factorial contract with feasible budget and timeline

title: 公开数据下的锚点核心方向分析复现
question: 在一个来源清楚的公共CRLM单细胞队列中，能否以供体为单位复现SPP1相对SELENOP巨噬细胞程序的组织方向并暴露原方法的敏感性？
target_object: published SPP1 versus SELENOP macrophage contrast
comparison: CRC versus CRLM versus adjacent liver within one audited public cohort
primary_outcome: donor-level direction and QC sensitivity of the published contrast
claim_ceiling: analysis reproduction and methods-learning baseline only
falsifier: public files cannot be mapped to donor and tissue or the published direction is not recovered under any defensible locked specification
anchor_reuse: myeloid zoom-in;SPP1 versus SELENOP contrast;one central Figure role
changed_axes: large integrated atlas reduced to one traceable cohort;patient-level repair added
science_basis: This is useful for learning and for testing reconstructed modules but is too close to the anchor's central result to be a standalone target-paper route.
main_risk: Technical success could be mistaken for manuscript novelty
stop_condition: retain as training even if successful;do not promote as a target paper without a separately reviewed distinct question

title: 再构建一个SPP1+TAM预后或肝转移signature
question: 能否从SPP1+TAM差异基因构建新的CRC预后或肝转移模型？
primary_outcome: overall survival or liver metastasis classification
falsifier: performance does not survive untouched validation and calibration
anchor_reuse: bulk bridge and clinical Figure role
changed_axes: new feature-selection algorithm or gene list
science_basis: The anchor already reports prognosis and liver-metastasis AUC, while many 2025-2026 papers publish SPP1 or macrophage signatures. A new gene list alone does not create a distinct paper and maximizes leakage risk.
main_risk: Near-certain substantive duplication and optimistic validation
stop_condition: stop at direction audit unless a genuinely different clinical decision and untouched external cohort are first demonstrated

falsifier: results reduce to cancer composition or reproduce the known CXCL9:SPP1 polarity literature
science_basis: Science 2023 already established CXCL9:SPP1 macrophage polarity and coordinated pan-cancer programs; a generic expansion would be a direct conceptual duplicate.
